title: Meter (a tester's counter: bytes and packets sent to apps)
summary: Counts what the Stump sends people's apps over LXMF: bytes of text, bytes as sent, and how many messages fit one LoRa packet. /meter shows the numbers, /meter 1|2|3 sends a fixed test text. The same on any firmware since 1.0.0-beta.53, to compare a kit before and after packed text (1.0.0-beta.82). It changes nothing that is sent.
hooks: /meter (slash only, up to 3 lines over the mesh)
mesh_out, priority 95: counts each message to a person's app, never changes it
on_message, priority 95: counts each room line written from a person's app, never answers
every 60 s: counts the minutes (a board's clock jumps when it learns the time)
a counter in front of rrc_mesh._send_item (in memory, no file changed): counts what goes to other Stumps, then calls the real function with the same item

runtime_storage.note: Nothing is stored: the counters start again with the Stump.
